title: Cookie & Local Storage Policy
shortSummary: Details technical cookies and local storage tokens used for session authentication and preferences.

sections.heading: 1. Technical Cookies & Local Storage
paragraphs: Histeria uses strictly essential cookies and browser Local Storage to enable authentication, store JWT tokens, and remember selected organization context.
We do not use third-party tracking pixels or ad retargeting cookies.
bullets: histeria_jwt_token (LocalStorage): Encrypted JWT session token for user authentication.
histeria_selected_org_id (LocalStorage): Preserves currently active organization selection across dashboard views.
histeria_user_data (LocalStorage): Local user profile state representation.
g_state (Cookie): Managed directly by Google Identity Services when using Google Sign-In.
